finalText:
All 11 application files migrated to `db.execute({ sql, params })` and confirmed to load without syntax errors.

`vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still calls `db.query` twice — left untouched since the file header says it's a vendored copy replaced wholesale on every upgrade and "do not edit." `db.query` in `lib/db.js` stays in place since `vendor` depends on it; removing it would break the vendored adapter. Flagging this: if you want the migration fully complete, the fix belongs upstream in legacy-orm's own repo, not here.
